Title: Azure Enterprise Agreement Support Plan Upgrade Offer extended until June 30, 2018

Body.Content:
The Enterprise Agreement Support Plan Upgrade Offer, as announced last year, is being extended until June 30, 2018.

This offer is for customers who buy Microsoft Azure services on an Enterprise Agreement. It provides an additional level of access to expert support from Microsoft, at no charge.

Current customers qualify for 12-month renewal as long as they meet the eligibility qualifications. New customers are enrolled automatically within 45 days of meeting eligibility qualifications.

To get more information, visit the offer details page, contact your account manager or Azure Enterprise Agreement support, or use the help/support link in the Enterprise Portal.
